description.default: Upload a document to WebDAV / FTP / SFTP / a local folder, in one of three export formats: a byte-identical SiYuan HTML folder (highest fidelity), Markdown plus the assets its body references, or a single self-contained Word (.docx) file. Incremental upload, dry run, an upload dashboard, change detection and remote-folder cleanup. It uploads files; serving them as a website is your server's job.
description.zh_CN: 一键将文档上传到 WebDAV / FTP / SFTP 服务器或本地目录，导出格式三档可选：「HTML (SiYuan)」整页（还原度最高，自带运行时）、「Markdown」正文 + 它真正引用到的资源、「Word (.docx)」单个自包含文件（图片内嵌）。增量上传、试算、上传看板、改动检测、删除远端文件；双链、块嵌入与图片资产全部保留。本插件负责把文件传上去，把这个目录当站点对外提供是你服务器的事。
